change: Align compact icon-only bookmark stars, move collection access into Account, and support private book/event saves with sign-in prompts.
source: Clean git archive of the committed apps/server, apps/web and Cloud Build configurations; concurrent workspace changes excluded.
behavior: 16px stars with 44px tap targets; stars align beside detail titles and with the first line of artist names.
Account contains bookmark access; standalone header, mobile-menu and footer bookmark shortcuts removed.
Artist, artwork, book and event saving uses stars and preserves the selected record and return destination through sign-in.
Artist and artwork browsing stays public; museums and persistent private bookmarks require login.
Local-debug bookmarks remain ephemeral; no member, session or catalogue fixtures written to the real local database.

database.rollback: Route API and web traffic back to their recorded previous revisions. Leave the additive bookmark tables and migration in place to preserve any member saves.

validation.productionChecks: Actual signed-out sessions; no auth-response mocks, Google login or bookmark writes. Verified small icon-only stars, tap targets, alignment, login prompts, return routes, restored focus and no horizontal overflow.
limitations: Real Google OAuth and authenticated production writes were not performed; local debug flows and backend tests cover saved states.
Production-sized member distributions and 10-million-artwork capacity still require dedicated load testing.
